headline: Andoni Iraola goes viral at grassroots game: 'He must be a down-to-earth fella'
description: Andoni Iraola has gone viral for an appearance at a children's grassroots football match.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Manchester United eye Newcastle defender Malick Thiaw
description: Manchester United are among the clubs interested in Newcastle United center back Malick Thiaw. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Mauricio Pochettino can't fix Man United on his own, the owners have to do their jobs
description: Mauricio Pochettino's job at Manchester United isn't to fix the club, but to get results and make the players better. The real changes need to be made at the very top.

headline: Mauricio Pochettino to Man United: Is Tottenham love affair finally over?
description: Mauricio Pochettino is back in the Premier League as the new Man United boss. For Tottenham fans, it's complicated.

headline: Declan Rice agrees in principle to new five-year Arsenal deal - sources
description: Arsenal midfielder Declan Rice has agreed in principle a new five-year deal which will see him extend his time at the club until 2031, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Max Dowman, 16, becomes youngest England U21 goalscorer with winner against France
description: Arsenal's Max Dowman became England under-21s' youngest ever goalscorer by grabbing a late winner in a 3-2 victory over France at Ashton Gate.
